reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: cancel() is live production code with a non-test caller in LegionSealedBidAuctionSale.sol:203 (super.cancel()). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions map; no lookup possible. Gate 3: the finding is a concrete modifier-mismatch invariant violation (whenNotPaused on cancel() contradicts the property assertion), not a generic centralization risk. The spec deviation is confirmed — cancel() unconditionally carries whenNotPaused across all implementations, blocking the project owner from canceling during a Legion-initiated security pause. The deadlock attack path (exploit triggers pause → project owner can't cancel → Legion must unpause re-exposing the exploit) is plausible but requires preconditions, warranting CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.
